output.source_text: Because the octave is divided equally into 6 whole steps, there are only 2 distinct whole tone scale collections in total across all 12 keys. Collection 1 contains {C, D, E, F#, Ab, Bb}; Collection 2 contains {B, C#, Eb, F, G, A}.

note_vi: Bài 21 của nguồn Jazz Scales (YouTube), mốc 01:11-02:15. Because the octave is divided equally into 6 whole steps, there are only 2 distinct whole tone scale collections in total across all 12 keys. Collection 1 contains {C, D, E, F#, Ab, Bb}; Collection 2 contains {B, C#, Eb, F, G, A}. Nguồn giảng bằng tiếng Anh, câu trên giữ nguyên lời giảng.
